title: Mapping Mathematical Hardness: Machine-Assisted Conjecture Discovery and the Quantification of Non-Triviality
summary: Machine-assisted mathematical discovery has been a long-standing challenge in machine learning and artificial intelligence. In recent years, we have seen tremendous progress with generative AI, yet its contribution to automated discovery in advanced mathematical research has been limited. One of the most difficult benchmarks in this context is the Birch test, which asks whether a machine can discover truly novel and non-trivial mathematical structures without human intervention.
